proposals.description: NBRC 1221 and NBRC 1474 each name a 1 M HEPES-KOH stock and add 20 ml. The reported pH values 7.14 and 9.0 belong to the receiving media. Stock pH, neutralization ratio and solvent are unreported. These omissions prove neither equality nor difference. The two accessions support the same bounded nominal preparation description; whether one shared nominal owner or a more specific source-supported representation should be installed remains a coordinator decision under #1237. This identifier is retained only as a conditional historical proposal handle, not a selected stable owner. Do not install both candidates as proven distinct substances. Preserve both source and occurrence routes, all component uncertainty and all inherited holds.
proposals.publication_obligations: Coordinator must guard exact baseline before bytes, reconcile cross-shard owners, apply via guarded writer, synchronize individual/aggregate/SSSOM, and pass native full QC. Preserve every WITHHOLD/REJECTED/source-material/export decision. These isolated proposals confer no release or full-owner approval.
proposals.identity_consequence: Conditional historical candidate only; coordinator family identity decision pending.
proposals.predicate_consequence: No family-owner installation or released identity row is approved by this conditional candidate.

changes: Correct only the exact new campaign MappingEvidence entry identified by the W02 provenance audit from MANUAL_CURATION to LLM_SUGGESTION. Preserve inherited evidence and ComponentAssertion evidence types.

Withdraw unsupported inference of distinct preparation identity from accession number or missing qualifiers. Retain exact candidate/source/occurrence lineage for conditional family reconciliation under #1237.

W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-02 was reported before correction. Withdraw inferred buffer-moiety and potassium-species material partonomy. The source names only the 1 M HEPES-KOH stock; composition remains unknown. Preserve its nominal strength in the whole-stock description. No solvent, free KOH, neutralization ratio or component molarity is inferred. The original component objects are preserved in the immutable finding and prior payload.
